title: The Missing Oar
scene: At 6:20 PM, the club spare oar vanished. Fog closed the boathouse slip from 6:00 to 6:40.

suspects.name: Rosie Kade
suspects.testimony: I was rigging shells in the main bay from 6:05 to 6:35.
suspects.alibiProof: The bay camera shows Rosie rigging at 6:08, 6:20 and 6:33.

suspects.name: Felix Dunne
suspects.testimony: I was at the slip end at 6:20, watching the fog roll in.
suspects.contradiction: The slip gate was chained from inside at 6:02, and the oar rack key hangs only on Felix's belt.

suspects.name: Anika Rao
suspects.testimony: I was stretching with the crew in the locker room at 6:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The crew group photo at 6:19 has Anika in the front row.

suspects.name: Tomas Vale
suspects.testimony: I was fixing the winch in the workshop from 6:10 to 6:30.
suspects.alibiProof: The tool log shows Tomas signing out a wrench at 6:11 and returning it at 6:29.
